title: Spider-Man (2000)/Enemies
text:
Henchmen  
Serve as the most basic enemies in the game, but are only common in the early stages. Recognizable by their dual guns. Unlike most ovf the enemies they can be fully entangled in Spidey's webbing.

Bank Thug  
The bank thugs are upgraded versions of the normal henchman and boast laser targeting rifles. They are only seen in the bank level.

Policeman  
The policemen serve are enemies to Spider-Man after he was framed.

SWAT Cop  
Upgraded version of the basic policeman.

Lizardman

Symbiote
Able to go up ceilings. Vulnerable to Burning Web.
